d:
Israel’s political crisis deepens after the October 27 elections, as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s Likud party challenges the election results, alleging foreign interference. The Central Elections Committee has rejected the demand to delay certification.
With no political bloc securing a majority, Netanyahu is pushing for a broad national unity government while ruling out dependence on Arab parties Ra’am and the Joint List. Meanwhile, opposition leaders are rallying behind Gadi Eisenkot to try to form an alternative government.
